Additional Information - Requirements &.one: Document checklists for filing applications and for every change (endorsement) to an existing certificate.

pts: Index, page numbering, every page authenticated by the authorised signatory
Authorisation for the signatory: notarized BOD resolution / affidavit / partnership deed
Notarized affidavit listing endorsements made earlier on the certificate (specimen given)
New application: five folders 241 (chemical) / 243 (bio) · 9(3B) extension 245
Company / factory / office changes 256, 257, 264 · Transfer 258
Source of import changes 259–261, 267, 272–274 · Packaging 255 · Shelf life 262, 270
Free Sale Certificate 263 · Duplicate certificate 269 · Revalidation 271

Requirements for the submission of appli.one: How to split a 9(3) / 9(3B) chemical pesticide application into five folders (266th RC, 2006).

pts: Index, numbering, authentication, Form-I, fee DD, stamped envelopes, BOD resolution, 9(3B) certificate if any
Form-I copy, chemistry data, labels, RTT permit, MRL proforma
Form-I copy, bio-efficacy data, composition, MRL proforma
Form-I copy, toxicity data, composition, specification, adjuvant details, MRL proforma, labels
Form-I copy, packaging and labelling data

watch: Each folder is marked Complete / Deficient at receipt; a deficient file is not accepted for scrutiny

Requirements for submission of applicati.one: The five-folder format for a 9(3) / 9(3B) biopesticide application.

pts: Form-I, fee DD, envelopes, notarized BOD resolution
Notarized affidavits on NJSP: composition, GMO-free, free from chemical / botanical pesticides
Proof of strain deposit in the National Repository (reference code)
Chemistry: biological characteristics + copies of the legal affidavits
Bio-efficacy: data + summary in duplicate · Toxicity: data, specification, adjuvants
Packaging: packaging and labelling data

Requirements for Extension of Provisiona.one: Checklist to extend a provisional 9(3B) registration, for chemical pesticides and biopesticides.

pts: Standard file items, Form-I, fee DD, stamped envelopes
Justification for the extension
Copies of all earlier certificates for the product
Details of data generated to meet the provisional conditions: chemistry, bio-efficacy, toxicity, packaging

Requirements for the registration of pes.one: Checklist for FIM vs FIT: making in India a formulation identical to an imported one already registered.

pts: Standard file items, Form-I, fee DD, envelopes
Notarized: BOD resolution, composition affidavit, licence, PAN, incorporation
Proof the technical source is registered (RC meeting reference)
FI registrant's name and the RC meeting that approved it
ATR from an independent lab, labels, and a sample for CIL

watch: Deemed registration of the technical is not accepted

Requirement for 9(4) Tim Cases Under Ins.one: Checklists for 9(4) me-too registration of technical (TIM) and formulation (FIM) made in India (256th RC, 2005).

pts: Legal: standard file items, fee DD, envelopes, Form-I
Chemistry: composition, specification, ATR from independent lab, impurities, chemical equivalence
Full process with equations, flow sheet, effluent treatment; in-process sample ATR from CIL
Toxicology: acute oral, dermal, skin and mucous membrane irritation
Standard file items, Form-I, fee; notarized BOD, licence, PAN, incorporation, product list

Requirement under Section 9(4) Ti/Fi Cat.one: Checklist for 9(4) me-too registration of an imported technical (TI) or formulation (FI).

pts: Standard file items, fee DD, envelopes, Form-I
Notarized: BOD resolution, licence, PAN, incorporation certificate
Consent letter legalised by the Indian Embassy / High Commission in the source country
Products registered, licensed and manufactured in the last 2 years

Requirement for the registration of pest.one: Checklist for export-only registration, plus the checklist for label expansion u/s 9(3).

pts: Chemexcil certificate, Form-I, composition, BIS no. or specification and method
7 copies of labels; source of import or process of manufacture as applicable
Same chemistry plus acute toxicity; technical also reproduction, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity
Registration certificate, signatory authorisation, affidavit on earlier expansions
Bio-effectiveness, phytotoxicity, residues, persistence, foreign MRLs, MRL proforma in duplicate
7 copies of revised labels in English and Hindi; field-data summary in duplicate

Requirement for the label expansion of i.one: Checklist to add new uses (label expansion) to a household insecticide.
nums: national labs, at least 2 repeated trials each
labels / leaflets in Hindi and English

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier label expansions
Bio-effectiveness from three national laboratories
Secondary pest outbreaks (ticks, mites) where residual pyrethroids are used
Persistence on surfaces from 3 labs; for coils / mats / vaporisers, concentration in air instead

Requirement for the endorsement of bio-e.one: Checklist for a 9(4) registrant to add a bio-efficacy claim to the label / leaflet.
nums: certificate older than this: State proof that production has started

pts: Standard file items and notarized BOD resolution
Notarized certificate with the approved label / leaflet
Affidavit on earlier endorsements

Requirement for the endorsement of new/a.one: Checklist to change, or add, packaging on an existing certificate.

pts: Standard file items, justification for the change, copy of the certificate
Primary, secondary and transport packaging details
Content–container compatibility data
New packaging material: storage-stability performance of the container
New material, or a pack size not in BIS: transport worthiness test

Requirement for the endorsement of chang.one: Checklist to change the company or firm name on registration certificates.

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier endorsements
Copy of the certificate of registration
Company: MoA & AoA and fresh incorporation certificate from the Registrar of Companies
Firm: partnership deed
Affidavit that no court case is pending under the Insecticides Act
Factory: NOC from State Director of Agriculture · Office: full head and branch office address

Requirement for the endorsement of facto.one: Checklist to add a factory address for the first time, shift the factory, or add a second factory.

pts: Standard file items, affidavit on earlier endorsements, copy of the certificate
Approved labels / leaflets, or 7 copies if not approved earlier
All of the above + NOC from the State Director of Agriculture

Requirement for the transfer of certific.one: Checklist to transfer a registration certificate from one person or company to another.

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier endorsements
Joint notarized application on NJSP by both parties, for each certificate
…with commissioning date, factory address and last year's production
Attested manufacturing licence listing the products
Incorporation certificate with MoA & AoA; partnership / dissolution deed
Registered sale deed, gift or inheritance document

watch: If a court case under the Act is pending, an NOC from the court is needed for the transfer
